summary.text: Abigail Geer is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 86 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website describes her as a working parent who has also cared for her parents.

paragraphs.text: Geer writes on her campaign website that she is raising her daughter in the district, is the primary provider for her household and has rearranged her work to care for her parents.
She says she has worked a range of jobs and has not followed a conventional political path.
Geer advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

Her site lists child care, health care access, jobs and small businesses, emergency medical and fire services, support for seniors and public education among her priorities for Casco, Frye Island, Poland and Raymond.
